svg.text: Eight public-interest trade-offs | people before showcase efficiency
Jing-Zhang Open Pulse · explicit stance, affected groups, release evidence and exit boundary

g.text: Ordinary return beats the showcase route
Public route ↔ display, event and robot windows
Stance: secure step-free, account-free, screen-free access first
Evidence: 09-accessible-route · 27-robot-public-route | exit: route break
Skill continuity beats automation replacement
Automation efficiency ↔ jobs, small business and maintenance access
Stance: manual equivalent, reskilling and appeal before scale
Evidence: human-first-buffer · 29-non-ai-equivalence | exit: interface monopoly
Explainable public service beats black-box convenience
City API convenience ↔ eligibility, responsibility and correction
Stance: minimum fields, human explanation, correction and withdrawal
Evidence: city-api-energy-contract · 22-privacy-minimization | exit: no accountable owner
Cool, quiet and safe routes beat night-time growth
Night vitality ↔ heat, noise, glare, flooding and return
Stance: quiet chain and ordinary return are prerequisites
Evidence: wind-health-validation · 16-noise-equity | exit: reduce capacity
Reciprocal contribution beats unpaid attention
Global AI week and open display ↔ consent, attribution and withdrawal
Stance: purpose, support, revocability and a return of results
Evidence: participation-cycle · 33-rights-clearance | exit: remove uncleared material
Maintainable assets beat one-off smart devices
Screens, sensors and interfaces ↔ spares, ownership and retirement
Stance: owner, maintenance clock and ordinary substitute first
Evidence: resource-accounts · 35-maintenance-sla | exit: stay conceptual
Group differences beat a flattering average
Overall average ↔ different lived experiences across groups
Stance: compare groups, day/night and seasons; disclose unknowns
Evidence: public-interest-audit · 21-participation-differences | exit: pause if unexplained
Reversible learning beats permanent commitment
Brand, procurement and fixed-space promise ↔ correction and exit
Stance: versioned evidence closes the loop; unknown is not success
Evidence: 39-phase-gate · 40-scale-retire | exit: broken evidence or harm

svg.text: 8 positions · 14 scenarios / 8 operations / 10 public-interest groups | conceptual register, not a survey, approval, field result or deployment permit
